description: Get the current authenticated user (the owner of the token used for this Box session).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the user object (type, id, name, login, role, status, language, timezone, space_amount, space_used, max_upload_size, job_title, phone, created_at); on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single folder by its id.

folder_id.description: The unique id of the folder.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the folder object (type, id, name, description, size, created_at, modified_at, item_count, parent, owned_by); on failure (folder not found), output contains an error message.

description: List the items (subfolders and files) contained in a folder, with pagination.

folder_id.description: The unique id of the folder whose items are listed.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return in the page (default 100).

offset.description: Zero-based offset into the full entry list for pagination (default 0).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with total_count, entries (folder and file objects), offset, and limit; on failure (folder not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get a single file's metadata by its id.

file_id.description: The unique id of the file.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the file object (type, id, name, description, size, extension, sha1, created_at, modified_at, parent, owned_by); on failure (file not found), output contains an error message.

description: Download the text content of a file by its id (text/markdown/json/xml/yaml/csv/pdf only).

file_id.description: The unique id of the file to download.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with file_id, name, mime_type, size_bytes, and content; on failure (file not found, unsupported mime, missing fixture, or too large), output contains an error message.

description: Search folders and files by name substring, optionally filtered by type, with pagination.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive substring matched against item names.

type.description: Optional type filter; 'folder' or 'file' to restrict results to that type.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return in the page (default 100).

offset.description: Zero-based offset into the full entry list for pagination (default 0).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with total_count, entries (matching folder and file objects), offset, and limit; on failure, output contains an error message.
